QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Angelic Buster's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Angelic Buster again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Angelic Buster's message is for the Nova Guardian, #bKaiser#k. She considers him the representative of the Nova soliders who came to Maple World. You'll find Kaiser at the #bgolden dragon bench#k of the Lunar New Year party.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Angelic Buster's message to #bKaiser#k, but he kept making weird noises. It was hard to tell whether he was cheering or screaming. One thing is certain. #bHis morale is through the roof.#k

default.0: Kaiser is at the #bgolden dragon bench#k of the Lunar New Year party.
